event: You grin: "Let's try that burst of speed." You face down the open, stony bank and reach for wind.

memory.fact: Downstream of the ford the bank runs open and stony for fifty yards and more.

event: The pressure answers cooler; wind opens ahead like a door, and a push at your back throws you on.

changes.note: Her wind dash spends a Surge's 10 mana
Her wind dash spends 1 wind
Her fire reserve has refilled from the beam

event: Fifty yards of shore go by in a few heartbeats; you let go of the wind and skid to a stop, unhurt.

memory.fact: Loosed as wind, Starfall Surge carried Nala fifty yards along the shore in a few heartbeats.

event: A small cool hollow behind your breastbone fills back in; you're breathing hard, but not tired.

memory.fact: Loosing wind answers cooler than fire and leaves a small cool hollow that fills back in on its own.

event: "Nice! Okay, time to try the ward." At the water's edge you reach for earth, for stone armour.
Flat grey stones lift out of the stream and lock onto you like fish scales, down to stone boots.

changes.note: Her stone ward spends a Surge's 10 mana
Her stone ward spends 1 earth
Her wind reserve has refilled

memory.fact: Loosed as earth, Starfall Surge drew riverbed stones onto Nala as flowing, scaled stone armour.
Loosing earth answers slow and heavy and leaves a small heavy hollow that fills back in on its own.
A Starfall Surge ward gives ward 4 against blows at legacy rank 1, and holds about a minute.

event: It weighs almost nothing and moves like skin; a knuckle on the chest plate rings like a stone step.

memory.fact: Her stone armour weighs almost nothing, its weight resting on the pressure, and moves like skin.

event: After about a minute the plates let go all at once and clatter into a ring of wet stones.

memory.fact: Her stone armour held about a minute, then fell away all at once into a ring of wet stones.

event: Status: Level 2; Health 45/45, Mana 106/136, Stamina 36/36; every reserve full again.
"I'll need to practice holding spells." You call the armour again and hold it past its minute.

memory.fact: A Surge working held past its minute costs its mana and element again for each minute more.

event: You add wind on top: two pulls sit side by side behind your breastbone, one heavy, one cool.

memory.fact: Holding earth and wind at once, she feels two pulls behind her breastbone, one heavy, one cool.

event: Dashes, turns, a jump of yards: the wind throws you faster than your feet expect, but you stay up.

memory.fact: Stone armour with wind speed let her dash, turn and jump yards, faster than her feet expected.

event: Each renewal dips Earth and Wind to 19, and they creep back; mana drops a step and stays down.

changes.note: Renewing the held armour and wind costs mana
Renewing the held workings again costs mana

memory.fact: Her reserves refill faster than held workings drain them, so her mana runs low first.

event: Then mana jumps up on its own, to 99, and goes on falling a step at a time.

changes.note: Her mana comes back 13 at a jump while she holds the workings

memory.fact: While she held workings, her mana once jumped up on its own, then went on falling.

event: After some three minutes you reach for water: a thin disc of water whirls up above your palm.

memory.fact: Her water working took the form of a thin disc of water spinning fast above her palm.

event: All three workings slip at once; spray bursts in your face and the stone scales clatter off.

changes.note: Holding three minutes of workings drains her mana to 49
Her earth reserve refills after the workings slip

memory.fact: At legacy rank 1 she can keep two workings going at once; a third makes all of them slip.

event: "Okay, I guess three is my limit, for now." You count your pulse and watch the mana line.
Past six hundred beats, about ten minutes, mana jumps thirteen all at once, to 62.

changes.note: Ten minutes' rest returns 13 mana

event: You sit on a flat dry stone and box-breathe; the mana line does not move any faster.
Near ten minutes again it jumps thirteen more, to 75. The breathing calmed you, not the mana.

changes.note: Another ten minutes returns 13 mana

memory.fact: Her mana comes back 13 at a time, in one jump every ten minutes.
Slow box breathing calms her, but does not speed her mana's return.

event: "Ten percent every ten minutes. Let's see about shelter." You will a dome of stone around you.
Stones rise from the streambed, about a barrow-load to a draw, and settle round you in a ring.

memory.fact: At legacy rank 1 one earth draw moves about a barrow-load of stone.

event: You let each pull go and each ring stays on its own weight; the wall climbs to your shoulders.

changes.note: Her mana jumps 13 while she builds the wall

memory.fact: Stones she sets to rest on one another stay put after the working ends, as dry-stone.

event: The fourth draw tries to close the top; the inward stones slide, held up by the pull alone.
The pull slips; the roof and half the wall crash down in a roar, and you throw yourself flat.

changes.note: Four earth draws for the shelter spend 40 mana

memory.fact: Stone shaped and held by a working falls apart the moment the working ends.

event: Unhurt, you lie in a knee-high, gapped ring of stone round a heap of fallen stone. Mana 48.

memory.fact: Above the waterline stands a knee-high, gapped ring of stone round a heap of fallen stone.

event: A while later boots scrape on the ridge track, and two people come down to the water's edge.

changes.note: Waiting by the ruined shelter returns 13 mana

memory.fact: She and Tobin reach Greyfen Ford on Sootjaw's trail a little after eleven on day one.

event: A lean, weathered woman in patched green leathers leads, longbow in hand, a spear across her back.

memory.fact: She came to the ford in patched green leathers, a longbow in hand and a spear across her back.
She is lean and weathered, with a grey-streaked black braid and the tip of her left ear missing.

event: She looks long at the dead beast in the shallows, then across the water at you in the stones.
You get up and brush off the grit. "I seem to have gotten a bit lost. Where are we precisely?"
A gangly, sunburnt youth with a hunting bow gapes beside her; chipped tooth, jerkin too big.

memory.fact: He came to the ford with Hessa: gangly, sunburnt, chipped front tooth, a hunting bow in hand.
His leather jerkin is too big for him.

event: "Greyfen Ford. The fen's west of you. Fenwatch is an hour east, over the ridge."

memory.fact: Folk call this crossing Greyfen Ford, after the Greyfen, the marsh that lies west of it.
Fenwatch, the hunter's village, lies an hour's walk east over the ridge, the nearest folk.

event: "This is the Western March. Aubrevine. The Vinelands, if you're from further in."

memory.fact: The ford is in the Western March of the Kingdom of Aubrevine, which its folk call the Vinelands.
She is human, and understands and speaks the common tongue without knowing how.

event: "I'm Hessa Vane. I hunt for Fenwatch. That's the Brute that's been taking our goats."

memory.fact: She gives her name as Hessa Vane, hunter of Fenwatch.
The dead Brute at the ford is the beast that has been taking Fenwatch's goats.

event: "We tracked it here from the village. Who killed it?"

memory.fact: She and her young companion tracked the Brute from Fenwatch to the ford.
Asked where this is, she answers plainly and gives her name, then asks who killed the Brute.

event: "That was me. If you'll help with transport, I'd be happy to contribute it for a feast."

memory.fact: Nala claimed the Brute's kill and offered it for a village feast in return for help moving it.

event: Hessa wades to the carcass and looks over the neat round hole burned clean through, chest to back.

memory.fact: Seeing the burn through Sootjaw's chest, she believes Nala killed it, though not how.

event: Tobin splashes after her: "There's no arrow. It's cooked right through, Hessa!"
"Your kill, then. There's a bounty on it. One gold and the pelt, from the reeve at Fenwatch."

memory.fact: Hessa judged Sootjaw Nala's kill after looking over the burn through its chest and back.
Fenwatch pays a bounty of one gold and the pelt to whoever kills it.
Fenwatch has a reeve, who pays the bounty on Sootjaw.

event: "Brute's tough eating, but stewed long it'll feed half the village."

memory.fact: Stewed long, Sootjaw's tough meat would feed half of Fenwatch.

event: "It's the weight of three men. I'll skin and quarter it here."

memory.fact: Sootjaw's carcass weighs as much as three grown men.
Hessa is skinning and quartering Sootjaw at the ford, to be carted to Fenwatch.

event: "Tobin. Back to the village. Borrow a cart. Tell the reeve the Brute's dead." He runs off.

memory.fact: Hessa's young companion is named Tobin.
Hessa sent Tobin back to Fenwatch to borrow a cart and tell the reeve the Brute is dead.

event: Hessa draws her skinning knife. Without looking up: "You've a name, lady?" "Nala."

memory.fact: While she skinned the Brute, Hessa asked Nala her name.
Alan woke in a woman's body, and in this body she calls herself Nala.

event: You cross the ford; the crossing stones are cold and slick, and the water barely wets your ankles.

memory.fact: The ford's crossing stones are cold and slick, and the water there barely wets the ankles.

event: "Mind if I watch?" Hessa eyes your bare feet: "Watch, then. Stand off the blood side."
She slits the hide belly to throat, then each leg, naming each cut as the knife goes in.

memory.fact: Skinned, the hide is slit belly to throat and down each leg, then worked off with a knife.
Hessa let Nala watch her skin the Brute, and named each cut as she made it.

event: Under the matted, stiff fur, the skin is thick and pale, threaded with fat.

memory.fact: Under its matted, stiff fur, Sootjaw's skin is thick and pale, threaded with fat.

event: At the burned hole: "That spoils it. Pelt's three silver now, not four."

changes.note: Watching the skinning, she regains 13 mana

memory.fact: The burn hole through its chest spoils part of the pelt, which now fetches three silver.
Unspoiled, Sootjaw's pelt would have fetched four silver.

event: She guts it into the current, "For the eels", and sets the small, hard heart on a stone.

memory.fact: Its heart is small and hard; hunters leave a Brute's guts in the water for the eels.

event: Jointing a foreleg, she asks, "Where are you from, Nala? Not the march."

memory.fact: At the skinning, Hessa asked Nala where she is from, and said she is not from the march.

event: "Oh, here and there. A bit of a rolling stone. Any good challenges near here?"

memory.fact: Nala told Hessa she is a rolling stone, always looking for a change and a challenge.
She takes 'here and there' as a lady not wanting to say, and does not press.

event: Hessa's knife pauses, then goes on; she lets where you're from drop.

memory.fact: Hessa let Nala's 'here and there' pass and did not ask again where she is from.

event: "A Drakewolf alpha holds the middle fen. Milky left eye. Ghost-Eye, we call it. It runs a pack."

memory.fact: Ghost-Eye, a big Drakewolf alpha with a milky left eye, leads a pack that holds the middle fen.
Ghost-Eye is half again a common Drakewolf's size, and its pack herds its prey into the water.
Ghost-Eye's Drakewolf pack holds the middle fen and hunts it at dawn and dusk.

event: "Wendlow's Hunters' Board has twenty-five gold on its head. Still uncollected."

memory.fact: Wendlow's Hunters' Board offers twenty-five gold for its head.
The Hunters' Board bounty on Ghost-Eye's head is still uncollected.

event: "Harl Voss, east: deserters holding Cutter's Quarry, a day down the road. They toll every cart."

memory.fact: Harl Voss and a dozen-odd deserters hold Cutter's Quarry, a day east, and toll the road.
Harl Voss's crew deserted from the king's levy, and toll every cart that passes Cutter's Quarry.

event: "The Board has thirty gold on Voss, two on each of his."

memory.fact: Wendlow's Hunters' Board offers thirty gold for Voss and two gold for each of his crew.

event: She looks straight at you: "Neither of those is for one alone. Not for me, either."

memory.fact: Asked for challenges, she names Ghost-Eye and Voss's crew, and says neither is for one alone.

event: "Maybe I'll try one tomorrow. How far to Fenwatch? Money's never hard to get."

memory.fact: Nala told Hessa she may take on Ghost-Eye or Voss tomorrow, and never finds money hard to get.
Nala's easy talk of money and the fen reads to her as gentry bravado, and it worries her.

event: "An hour's walk east. Agathe Morrow, the reeve, pays the bounty on my word the kill was yours."

memory.fact: Agathe Morrow, Fenwatch's reeve, will pay the Sootjaw bounty on Hessa's word the kill was Nala's.

event: "Tobin'll be back with a cart early afternoon. Wait, and walk in with it. I'll vouch for you."

memory.fact: Hessa said Tobin will be back at the ford with a cart early in the afternoon.
She'd have Nala wait for the cart and walk to Fenwatch with it, so she can vouch for the kill.

event: "And 'tomorrow' for Ghost-Eye or Voss is how people end up in the fen for the eels."

memory.fact: Hessa warned that putting off Ghost-Eye or Voss till tomorrow is how people end up in the fen.

event: "Money's easy come where you're from, maybe. Here it's not. Nor second chances."

memory.fact: Hessa told Nala that money is not easy come here, and nor are second chances.

event: You sit on a rock and watch her quarter the Brute and roll the pelt; the sun crawls across the sky.

memory.fact: Skinning and quartering it takes Hessa most of an hour at the water's edge.

event: In the early afternoon Tobin comes down the ridge track leading a mule in a two-wheeled cart.

memory.fact: Tobin came back to the ford early in the afternoon, leading a mule in a two-wheeled cart.
He comes back to the ford with the reeve's mule cart a little before half past one.

event: They load the quarters and pelt; you walk beside the cart up three switchbacks through pines.

memory.fact: The cart track climbs its western face from the ford in three tight switchbacks through pines.

event: From the crest the Greyfen spreads west; east, a palisade rings thatched roofs on a knoll.

memory.fact: From the crest one sees Fenwatch's smoke and palisade to the east and the whole Greyfen to the west.
A palisade of sharpened pine stakes rings the village, with a west gate and an east gate.
Houses are timber and wattle under thick fen-reed thatch, crowded close inside the palisade.

event: The cart comes down through stumps and rough pasture to the palisade's west gate.

memory.fact: From the crest the track runs down through stumps and rough pasture to Fenwatch's west gate.

event: Tobin's news ran ahead: a crowd at the gate stares at the cart, and harder at you, barefoot.

changes.note: Tobin's tale of the burned Brute has Fenwatch crowding the gate to see her

memory.fact: Tobin's news has a crowd of villagers at the west gate when the cart comes in on day one.

event: Your throat is dry; you haven't had a drink since you woke.
Hessa leads you onto the green, into a long hall of dark tarred timber, hearth, benches and ale.

changes.note: Hours of rest since the skinning fill her mana

memory.fact: The Tarred Stag, a longhall inn of dark tarred timber, sits on the green and is where all gather.

event: A round, bald, red-bearded man grins behind a table; beside him a stout woman of sixty on a staff.

memory.fact: A round, bald man with a bushy red beard stood grinning by the reeve in the Tarred Stag.
She is about sixty, stout and short, with an iron-grey braid pinned in a crown.

event: "Agathe. The Brute's dead. This is Nala. It was her kill. I saw the wound."

memory.fact: Hessa told the reeve the Brute was Nala's kill, saying she saw the wound.

event: "Then the bounty's hers." She counts one gold coin onto the table, in front of everyone.

changes.note: The reeve pays the Brute's bounty: one gold, 100 copper
The reeve owns the Brute's pelt as Nala's to sell

memory.fact: She pays the bounty as one gold coin, counted out on the Tarred Stag's table before witnesses.
Reeve Agathe Morrow has cried a bounty of one gold and the pelt for whoever kills Sootjaw.

event: You take the coin: heavy and cold, stamped gold. "Fenwatch thanks you, Nala."
Her voice carries the length of the hall: "I'm Agathe Morrow, reeve here. Where are you from?"

memory.fact: She leans on an ash staff, and her voice carries the length of a hall without her raising it.
She named herself to Nala as Agathe Morrow, reeve of Fenwatch.

event: "Where have you come from, and are you staying?"

memory.fact: Having paid the bounty, she asked Nala where she has come from and whether she is staying.
